title: Three Similar Words · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three Similar Words · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a common adjective such as happy or large. The lead gives three different words with approximately the same meaning. The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three Similar Words, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees the three words are reasonable synonyms in ordinary use.
